products.name: InShot AI
products.note: Mobile video editing AI; social content; cross-border data review advised

profile_text.body:
InShot is a mobile video and photo editing application aimed at content creators. The company describes its product as offering easy-to-use features alongside AI tools for video and photo editing, with capabilities that include transitions, green screening, music integration, filters, stickers, and caption tools. User reviews quoted on the site mention editing for social platforms such as Instagram and TikTok, and note the availability of both a free tier and a paid Pro version.

The site tracks one AI product under InShot, listed as InShot AI, categorized as a mobile video editing tool oriented toward social content creation. The held facts note that cross-border data review is advised in connection with this product, which may be relevant to users or organizations with data-handling considerations.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations appear in the available data for InShot.
